title: Artisan Bakery Website
description: A warm, appetite-driving marketing site for a boutique bakery, built around large product photography and a same-day ordering flow.
designGoal: Make the menu feel tactile and craft-driven while keeping the ordering path to two clicks.

title: Fitness & Gym Landing Page
description: A high-energy landing page for a fitness studio with animated stats, trainer profiles, and a class-booking CTA above the fold.
designGoal: Communicate intensity and motivation through motion and bold typography without hurting load performance.

title: Luxury Jewellery Showcase
description: An elegant, image-forward showcase for a jewellery brand with a slow-reveal aesthetic, product zoom, and a minimal color palette.
designGoal: Let the product breathe — restrained motion, generous whitespace, and premium typography over flashy effects.

title: SaaS Product Landing Page
description: A conversion-focused landing page for a B2B SaaS product with pricing tiers, feature comparison, and animated product mockups.
designGoal: Get from hero to pricing decision in under 30 seconds of scroll, with clear visual hierarchy at every breakpoint.

title: Restaurant Marketing Page
description: A single-page marketing site for a restaurant launch, combining a reservation widget, menu highlights, and a location map section.
designGoal: Drive reservations from mobile traffic first — mobile layout was designed before desktop.

title: Creative Agency Static Site
description: A fast, statically-generated portfolio site for a small creative agency, optimized for a 95+ Lighthouse score across the board.
designGoal: Ship a fully static, CDN-cacheable site that still feels alive through scroll-triggered reveals.
